main.description: Lists actors following one entity URI. Duplicate (actor, entity) relationships are collapsed before pagination using the earliest-created record and URI ascending tie-breaker. Results sort by each representative follow's (createdAt, uri) in sortDirection, default desc, with an opaque direction-bound cursor. Only the returned page is hydrated; missing profiles or organization sidecars remain explicit nulls. Operational failures return errors, not partial pages. Authentication is not required.

entity.description: Full DID-authority AT-URI of the followed record identity; matching does not pin a CID or restrict the target collection.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction for representative follow (createdAt, uri); default desc.

limit.description: Maximum relationships in the page; default 25.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor bound to sortDirection; keep all other query parameters unchanged.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The entity AT-URI, sort direction, page bound, cursor, or query parameters are invalid.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when there are no more relationships.
